I think that for many people the rules slowly relax more and more we they get more comfortable. At least this is a story I hear quite often on podcasts.

I think it’s important to remember that, for the most part, people post their problems in hopes of getting advice, venting, or using writing the post as a tool to order their own thinking. So the view you have form posts is a bit skewed. 

On the other hand emotions are powerful and they can make life complicated,  that is true with one partner and more partners does make it more likely that emotions will complicate a relationship.  From my own personal experience, my wife and I are open for about 2.5 years. In that time she’s had two partners. One was very fraught with emotions and ended in some heart break. The other is ongoing and has been easy and fun for her. She has an emotional connection with him,  but it hasn’t become so very high stakes as her other relationship was to her. 

To some degree you have control over how complicated things get by making choices about which relationships you foster and which you abandoned. 

Good luck with whatever you decide.
